1. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 还没吃了一个叫夹竹桃的植物：还没吃一个叫夹竹桃的植物，Use “没” without “了” to negate a completed action; “没吃” means that the action has not happened yet.

items.reason: The original wrongly uses 了 after 没, and in this context the intended experiential meaning requires 没吃过 rather than merely 没吃.
